# agent-identity-kit

> An evolving, evidence-first kit of 10 AI agent identities — give any AI coding assistant a full technical team. Built by a 16-year-old from a year of real use.

## Key documents

- [README.md](README.md): What it is, why it's different, dual-path quick start (ready-to-use vs adaptive exploration).
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Operation manual — how to use, how the kit evolves (distillation protocol).
- [EXPLORE.md](EXPLORE.md): Path B — adaptive exploration protocol (environment scan → trial → distill → personal fit).
- [EVOLUTION.md](EVOLUTION.md): Public evolution log — every version change and why.
- [EVIDENCE.md](EVIDENCE.md): Evidence list — real usage proof for every identity.
- [LESSONS.md](LESSONS.md): Lessons log — real mistakes and rules (organizational scars).
- [skills/](skills/): The 10 identity skills (architect / implementation / QA / docs / release / demo / security / community / planner / memory).
- [docs/design.md](docs/design.md): Design philosophy.
